utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the twenty-second of June. Have we got everyone on?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'm here. Still mourning the broken coffee machine in the canteen, though. That was a disappointing start.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: You say disappointing. I'd say the coffee was fairly disappointing when it worked.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Morning. Sorry, came in over the end of that. My headset's doing its own thing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Only coffee complaints. And the charity bake sale on Friday got a better reception than the coffee ever has. Anyway, enough cake chat.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's the shortest cake discussion we've ever had.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, closed stuff first, then what actually needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I finished the repair on the number two bearing last night. That's done, not something to carry into today's list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, closed. Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Same sort of update from me: finished the repair on the line two last night. Nothing outstanding on that repair.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Lovely. Two things off rather than another six on.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Just an observation from nights: noticed the dryer was running a bit warm, but it settled down. Not raising a job from that.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. Settled back down, so that's history rather than a new temperature job.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I heard a slight rattle from the line 1. Nothing to action yet, just mentioning what I heard.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Noted as an observation only. Neither of those is an extra action.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: On the blocked side, we can't get to the Boiler Safety Relief Valve until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And we're still waiting on parts for the Boiler Safety Relief Valve. Nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: So it's both access and parts, not just one of them.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Still blocked, no new action against it in this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Olu, can you chase the purchase order for the waste heat boiler, tomorrow at 9:30? It's not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: The purchase order itself, yeah? Not chasing a delivery date as well?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, just chase the purchase order for the waste heat boiler. Keep it to that.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Okay, I'll chase that tomorrow at 9:30. Not an emergency, but I won't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Got it. Separate from the valve parts discussion, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fiona Doyle, could you book a contractor to look at the Stretch Wrapper by 11am, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah. Just checking—booking made by 11am, not somebody physically here by eleven?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right, the booking by 11am. We're not agreeing a contractor visit time here.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Fine, I'll book a contractor to look at the Stretch Wrapper by 11am. I can fit that in.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: A spare minute. Rare bit of kit, one of those.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, well. The seals on the line one HPU also need replacing today, normal priority. Anyone able to take that?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Um, I can't take that on. Don't put my name against it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No capacity from me for the seals either, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, replacing the seals on the line one HPU stays unassigned. Still needed today at normal priority, but we've not got an owner.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I'll update the risk assessment for work on the CV01. I'll drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Han. Agreed, that takes precedence for you.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, the risk assessment update, to be clear. I'm not saying the work on the CV01 itself is signed off.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, understood. The document, not permission to crack on.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the Palletiser today at 2pm.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, Sarah, you were breaking up. You're taking both bits, the jam and the sensors?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Both, yeah. I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the Palletiser, today at 2pm.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Under isolation for access, obviously. Not a reach-in-and-wiggle-it situation.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Absolutely, under the proper isolation procedure. No shortcuts.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: There's also recalibrating the sensors on the dryer. That needs doing this afternoon. Not an emergency but don't let it slip. I can't take it, though—anyone else?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I can't cover that either. And just to separate it out, my warm-running comment wasn't a request for recalibration.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, separate item. The recalibration still needs doing, but no one's offered to own it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, recalibrate the sensors on the dryer: this afternoon, not an emergency but don't let it slip. Unassigned, not an agreed commitment from anyone.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the HV board on Monday. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Just the sign-off you're taking, not the HV switching itself?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Correct, I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the HV board. I'm not taking on switching.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Fiona Doyle. Monday is today, so that's clear, and the sign-off is yours.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep. That comes first for me because it's holding production up.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Han, can you check the guarding on the IM2 by Wednesday? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll check the guarding on the IM2 by Wednesday. Not an emergency, understood, but I won't let it drift.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And that doesn't displace the CV01 risk assessment. That's still your drop-everything one.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Exactly. CV01 risk assessment takes precedence; IM2 guarding check by Wednesday. Both clear.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's a fairly full page for a Monday morning.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And Teams only swallowed about half a sentence. We're improving.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Don't praise it. That's when it drops the call.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Any corrections to what we've agreed? Just corrections, rather than opening another list.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No corrections from me.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No, all clear here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, thanks everyone. We'll leave it there.
